Chapter 1131: 3 Meeting The Emperor (Request For Subscription)

Chapter 1131: Chapter 3 Meeting the Emperor (Request for Subscription)

The inventory of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s treasury, the recorded treasures, resources, inheritance guidance, and so on are indeed countless.

But those that fit the criteria set by Lin Yuan—

those that benefit him the most,

preferably inheritance guidance,

under 120,000 merit points.

Only a few meet these three conditions.

At a glance, there are only a few dozen.

Actually, the inventory of the treasury includes a large number of inheritance guides worth only hundreds to a thousand merit points, but they don’t have much effect on Lin Yuan.

“Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram?”

Lin Yuan carefully examined the introduction of such inheritance guides.

The Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram is inscribed with Chaos Secret Patterns, and the Chaos Secret Patterns are the essential veins of Chaos Rules.

It is also the only method Lin Yuan knows so far that can directly enhance the understanding of Chaos Rules.

Chaos Rules have long evolved into thousands of rules and paths with the creation of heaven and earth.

To enhance the understanding of other rules and paths, one just needs to comprehend the corresponding ones within the myriad rules and paths that operate in the world.

But Chaos Rules?

Among the myriad rules and paths that operate in the world, there are no Chaos Rules.

Thus.

The normal ways to enhance understanding of Chaos Rules can only be indirectly achieved by comprehending the myriad rules and paths.

However, Chaos Secret Patterns are the manifestation of Chaos Rules.

Comprehending Chaos Secret Patterns can directly enhance the understanding of Chaos Rules.

In the previous wars between Qingfen Domain and Purple Dream Domain, Lin Yuan comprehended many war machines, essentially comprehending the Chaos Secret Patterns contained within them.

“Didn’t expect there to be these Chaos Secret Patterns for exchange in the treasury.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself,

originally he planned to see if he could secure a war machine beyond grade A for comprehension.

“Indeed, even the opportunity to possess the Ancestor of Fierce Sun is available, what are mere Chaos Secret Patterns.”

Lin Yuan pondered silently.

The so-called absolute secrets of an ancient country are only relative.

Currently, Lin Yuan is the core royal family of the ancient country, and with enough merit, previous secrets are not so secret to him.

…

“Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram, there are eighty-one in total, among which there are nine representing the Chaos First Realm.”

“There are eighteen Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams for the Second Realm, the rest explain the Chaos Third Realm.”

Lin Yuan looked at the detailed introduction of the Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram.

Each of the nine Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams in the First Realm requires ten thousand merit points to exchange.

Together, they require ninety thousand merit points.

As for the eighteen Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams of the Second Realm, each exchange costs twenty thousand.

The fifty-four Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams of the Third Realm, each costs one hundred thousand merit points.

“My understanding of Chaos Rules is close to the peak of the Second Realm, so there’s no need to exchange the first nine diagrams, and for the eighteen diagrams of the Second Realm, only the last one or two need to be exchanged.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Given the constraint of only twelve thousand merit points, he naturally had to be frugal.

The Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram is explained in a sequence from shallow to deep based on Chaos Rules.

“Twelve thousand merit points, exchange for the last two diagrams of the Second Realm and the first diagram of the Third Realm.”

Lin Yuan looked at the diagrams, feeling the aura emanating from them, ensuring that the diagrams he purchased were parts of Chaos Rules he hadn’t comprehended yet.

For ease of selection, each Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram reveals a small part to prevent purchasing parts already comprehended.

“Fifty-four diagrams of the Chaos Third Realm… Unfortunately, I can only exchange for the first one now.” Lin Yuan glanced at the remaining fifty-three diagrams.

Additionally, Lin Yuan was quite tempted by other filtered inheritance guides, but after careful consideration, he chose the Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram.

“Still too poor right now.”

Lin Yuan thought, “but for me, the first diagram of the Chaos Third Realm is enough for now; as for the later diagrams, I can wait until I accumulate enough merit points.”

King Chibao had told him that, as the core royal family, there’s a fixed source of merit for everyone, including those Heavenly Venerates and kings, which is also the foundation of stability for the entirety of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Whether it’s the royal family or the Heavenly Venerates and kings, though there is internal strife, it is mainly for the ancient country’s interests.

The so-called strife is merely internal; when it affects the overall interests of the ancient country, whether royal family or Heavenly Venerates, they will unanimously face outward.

…

An illusory elder formed by flames patiently waited beside him. The treasury’s inventory of treasures, resources, and inheritance guides is all-encompassing, and anyone making a first selection will be dazzled, and even if they can’t afford it, there’s no problem in looking around for a while.

“I will exchange for these three Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams.”

Lin Yuan looked towards the illusory elder and spoke.

The illusory elder was slightly surprised, “Descendant of Fierce Sun, are you sure you don’t want to exchange for a superior weapon? Twelve thousand merit points are enough to exchange for several weapons and secret treasures at the Heavenly Venerate level.”

For every strong person, whether Great Lord or Heavenly Venerate, a suitable weapon secret treasure is the quickest and most substantial way to enhance one’s combat power.

As for inheritance guides like the Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram? How profound and mysterious are Chaos Rules, even with the Chaos Secret Patterns depicting the basic veins, who knows how long it would take to fully comprehend them.

It’s rare for Lin Yuan to use all twelve thousand merit points to exchange for such inheritance guides.

“I’m sure.” Lin Yuan nodded.

A suitable weapon secret treasure can be bought from outside, but such Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams are only available in the treasury.
